them.mo_ta: Numerous additional discrete shrubs and scrub clumps across the upper-left open plain, including a substantial cluster at the left edge. These are additional plant forms, beyond the original isolated trees and beyond a grass-texture change.
them.ly_do_thoi_dai: Natural Mediterranean scrub is compatible with 1779.

them.mo_ta: Numerous additional discrete bushes and scrub clumps across the upper-right coastal plain and around the distant camp, including larger clusters near the right edge.
them.ly_do_thoi_dai: Natural scrub is not an anachronism.

them.mo_ta: Additional individual shrubs and dense scrub clusters throughout the lower-left uncamped ground and central aisle, including the large foreground cluster near the bottom-left.
them.ly_do_thoi_dai: Natural scrub is compatible with the date.

them.mo_ta: Additional discrete bushes throughout the lower-right uncamped ground, around the existing grove, between the camps, and along the bottom edge; the original grove remains.
them.ly_do_thoi_dai: Natural scrub is compatible with 1779; no modern formal planting is evident.

them.mo_ta: Additional discrete exposed stones and small rock clusters scattered across the upper-left plain, outside the retained camp footprints; distinct from mere recolouring of soil.
them.ly_do_thoi_dai: Natural loose rocks are not chronologically anachronistic.

them.mo_ta: Additional discrete stones and rock clusters scattered across the upper-right plain, particularly toward its lower edge and around the scrub.
them.ly_do_thoi_dai: Natural rocks are compatible with 1779.

them.mo_ta: Additional scattered rocks and several prominent pale boulder groups throughout the lower-left uncamped foreground, including groups west and southwest of the left camp and along the bottom edge.
them.ly_do_thoi_dai: Loose natural rocks are not an anachronism; these are not new cliffs or buildings.

them.mo_ta: Additional loose rocks and pale boulder clusters in the lower-right uncamped terrain, including conspicuous groups below the supply stacks and near the bottom-right edge.
them.ly_do_thoi_dai: Natural rocks are compatible with the date.

bot_doi.mo_ta: The pale winding footpath through the lower-right open ground has been erased or largely obscured by the new vegetation and rocky ground. In BEFORE it curves left from beside the lower-right camp, then bends back toward the bottom edge.
